summary:
Implementation plan addressing:
1. Modal form state stabilization across all forms (Vehicle, Post, Event, Poll) to prevent text & photos disappearing on keypress/upload.
2. Custom Kickass (Love-You gesture icon) and Not Cool (Thumbs-down icon) reaction toasts replacing generic Updated box.
3. Social share sheet for garages with Facebook integration and prefilled 'Check out [First Name]'s Garage on Gascanco.' message.
4. Automatic card population in Live Feed with user first name and complete vehicle information.
